name: pathtrial
description: Local-evidence-first network diagnostics MCP for Codex, backed by the PathTrial CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, UDP, QUIC and proxies with auditable evidence.
interface.longDescription: PathTrial runs local, user-authorized network probes and returns structured evidence with probe IDs, findings, limitations and explicit uncertainty. It never uploads reports or changes system settings.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose why this authorized website is not reachable.
Compare IPv4 and IPv6 for this authorized target using PathTrial.
Explain this PathTrial JSON report and cite its evidence IDs.
